march_2009 = 6833543
sept_2009 = 7551862

arc_percent = (diff / average) * 100

print(f'September 2009: {sept_2009:,} million')
print(f'Difference: {diff:,}')
print(f'Average: {average:,.2f}')
print(f'Arc percent change: {arc_percent:.6f}%')
print(f'Rounded to 3 decimal places: {round(arc_percent, 3)}%')
"
